subject.title: CLI timeouts can replay active work and give misleading guidance

question: Should the remaining work be limited to a regression test and timeout-specific operator copy, including an explicit note that CLI-internal background work ends with its parent process?
rationale: The central retry guard appears present on current main, while the desired wording and scope of guidance for provider-owned background work are a maintainer-facing product and support contract.

options.title: Scope a focused follow-up
options.body: Keep the issue open for a narrowly tested copy-and-regression change covering active-work overall timeouts.

options.title: Treat current behavior as sufficient
options.body: Close after a maintainer confirms that the existing overall-timeout error and separate watchdog configuration are the intended operator experience.

recommendation.title: Scope a focused follow-up
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open for a narrowly tested copy-and-regression change covering active-work overall timeouts.
